$comment: Vendoring metadata for tools/iso3166_snapshot.json. The snapshot itself stays byte-for-byte identical to ISO 3166's iso3166.json. Read by tools/check_snapshot_freshness.py, which looks for `meta.review_by` in this sibling file. The snapshot itself carries no `meta.review_by`; the vendoring metadata lives here so the byte-for-byte property is preserved.
notes: The underlying data — alpha-2 codes, names, statuses — changes on the order of years.
Re-vendored from v1.6.7 for ISO 4217 amendment 180: BG currency_codes is ["EUR"] (was ["BGN"] in v1.5.2). The alpha-2 code set is unchanged.
When ISO 3166 ships an alpha-2 change, the notification rule fires and the snapshot is refreshed in the same PR.
